- Signed in, the wiki opens on your dashboard: where you are, Continue reading, the chapters you finished, your latest notes and the entries you opened last
- My notes: every note you wrote, by chapter. Without an account, notes are kept in this browser
- Each chapter's page and each entry let you add a note
- The menu starts with your Dashboard, then Reading, then the Index
- Before you read now has a Sign in button (signing in stays optional)
- The menu shows how many readers have the wiki open right now, and how many of them are at your chapter (only a chapter number is shared, nothing is stored)
- "ch N" on an entry, in its "Since ch …" lines and in its Timeline opens that chapter's page
- The Black Emperor pathway has its name (ch 323)
- Found by Alpha: chapter links that did not open from an entry
